summary: Frontend-only RevenueCat/auth mobile-web testing completed on preview URL. QA1 simulated purchase succeeded (Test Store), QA2 stayed free, restore paths validated, and account isolation mostly worked with one transient identity sync delay. Found two actionable issues: Google managed-auth redirect failure in this environment and subscription back navigation failure after direct-load/reload.

ui_bugs.issue: After direct route load/reload on /subscription, tapping back shows RN warning: 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator.' and does not return to workspace.

integration_issues.flow: Google sign-in button to managed auth
integration_issues.issue: Popup/redirect flow did not complete in automation; console showed 404 and net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED while attempting managed auth endpoint. Could not validate session exchange without human Google approval.
Immediately after login, entitlement can appear free/connecting before settling to verified/active (timing-sensitive). Requires short wait before assertion.

action_items: Fix subscription back behavior for direct-load/reload paths (fallback to router.replace('/') when no history).
Investigate managed Google auth redirect endpoint/network resolution in preview env; ensure popup/redirect opens reachable auth domain.
Consider exposing non-sensitive debug testID/text for current RevenueCat app user id/originalAppUserId in test builds to hard-assert identity binding pre-purchase.
Stabilize entitlement-ready state in UI assertions (or explicit loading gate) before showing free/pro outcome.
critical_code_review_comments: Identity binding verification is enforced in code before purchase, but there is no UI-surface test hook for getAppUserID/originalAppUserId, making strict black-box assertion difficult.
router.back() in subscription header is brittle for entry via direct URL/reload where history stack may be empty.
Google auth uses external managed URL; add robust failure UX when popup cannot open or domain is unreachable.
seed_data_creation: No new accounts created. Used existing QA1/QA2 credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on 390x844 and 360x800. RevenueCat Test Store simulated purchase succeeded using QA1 with product line 'pro.annual' and active Pro entitlement visible ('Pro is active · Test Store', renews date shown). QA2 remained free after restore/cancel path. For QA1 persistence checks, wait briefly for workspace-subscription-identity to move from 'Connecting…' to 'Verified' before asserting plan/entitlement.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction 1 (navigation): open /subscription directly or reload while on /subscription, then tap subscription-back-button -> GO_BACK not handled due missing history stack. Mitigation: detect cannotGoBack and route to '/'. Reproduction 2 (Google): from login tap google-sign-in-button in preview automation, popup did not resolve and console reported DNS/404 errors for auth flow. Mitigation: verify managed auth domain reachability and web popup fallback/redirect handling in preview infra.
